title: Cowdrey One
shortDescription: Every app by Bradley Cowdrey in one place, with which ones are on your phone.
fullDescription:
Every app, one place.

Cowdrey One gathers Bradley Cowdrey's free apps in one place: Cowdrey.MD, Meridian, Two Degrees and Bearings for Android, and Cowdrey.PDF and Golden Hour on the web. Each one is a tap away, and you can see at a glance which ones are already on your phone.

DISCOVER
• Each app on a card of its own, with a picture of the app and a Get button
• Get opens the app's own Google Play page, where you install it as usual
• An app without an Android version opens on the web, in your browser
• Every app in one list, with what it does in a line

WHAT'S ON YOUR PHONE
• Cowdrey One sees which of the apps are installed, and offers Open for those
• A ring counts how many you have; Get Every App lists the rest, with Get on each
• It never marks an app as installed because you tapped Get: only when it's really on your phone
• Google Play keeps the apps up to date

EACH APP'S PAGE
• Its screenshots in a row you swipe
• Version, price, platforms, category, privacy and developer
• What's New in the latest version
• About, features, every platform it's on, and links to its product page, source code and Terms

LIBRARY AND SHARE
• The Library lists the apps on your phone, with their versions, and the ones not on it yet
• Share shows a QR code that opens Cowdrey One on a friend's phone or computer, with Share and Copy Link
• Light and dark, following your phone or chosen in Settings

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. What Cowdrey One sees on your phone stays on your phone. The one request it makes itself is to GitHub's public releases list, for each app's latest version and what's new in it.

Free and open source (MIT License), like every app it lists. No ads, no account, no tracking.

Made by Bradley Cowdrey · bradcowdrey.com
